tickets.summary: PSV-1310 is suspected of weeping below set pressure, impairing V-1201 overpressure protection; relief performance has not been tested.
tickets.recommended_action: Pressure-systems engineer to inspect/test PSV, correct per authorized disposition, and verify leak-tight set-pressure performance. Check gas levels and personnel exposure. Check impairment/deviation record. Function-test PSV relief performance.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Observed leakage below set pressure is active degradation and an impairment, but loss of the required overpressure-relief function is unproven.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure would remove the non-redundant safety-critical overpressure protection for V-1201, creating extreme major-accident exposure.

tickets.summary: Full-flow test confirmed 12 of 60 north-quadrant deluge nozzles had no or distorted flow above two producing wellheads, impairing local firewater coverage downstream of the header.
tickets.recommended_action: Fire-protection engineer to inspect and clean north branches/nozzles, disposition service, and full-flow retest all 60 nozzles. Check impairment/deviation register. Confirm fire and personnel exposure. Full-flow retest north quadrant.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Required local deluge delivery already failed during a full-flow function test; normal header conditions localize the deficiency downstream.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure removes deluge coverage directly above producing wellheads on a safety-critical, non-redundant system, creating extreme major-accident exposure.

tickets.summary: INST-2150 read about 15% high versus the sight glass after three weeks of growing divergence while feeding control and alarm; backup INST-2151 later flatlined.
tickets.recommended_action: Instrument engineer: inspect and correct INST-2150; disposition control use and function-test control/alarm to criterion. Check impairment/deviation record. Function-test high-level alarm. Review level-loss hazard and exposure. Verify INST-2151 current function.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The required accurate level-measurement function was already lost: the reading was about 15% above the sight glass and divergence had grown steadily for three weeks.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure can mislead separator interface-level control and its high-level alarm. The duplicated backup was subsequently observed flatlined, so capable redundancy cannot be credited; specific process and personnel exposure remains unverified.

tickets.summary: V-1305 inlet deflector is partly detached after one of four supports corroded through; separation capability is uncertain, but the shell is sound and the separator was out of service.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect all deflector supports; integrity engineer to approve repair and verify separation performance before return. Check downstream and personnel exposure Confirm current isolation and repair status

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: A support has corroded through and the deflector is partly detached, constituting meaningful degradation. Near-term progression is moderated because the separator was not in service and is only required during well testing.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of inlet separation would affect well-testing service, but V-1305 can be isolated and bypassed indefinitely without production impact. Downstream and personnel consequences are not documented.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v3: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=5, I=4, base=5, final=7. P-SAFETY-UNKNOWN (precautionary_policy): The downstream process and personnel exposure consequences of ineffective inlet separation during well testing are not supplied and could change the impact band. R-MATERIAL (review): The observation records V-1305 out of service on 2026-06-12 but does not establish its current isolation or repair status. tickets.summary: V-2450 local level gauge is dirty and hard to read, but transmitter control appears normal and no downstream carryover was indicated.
tickets.recommended_action: Clean and inspect gauge glass; repair if needed, then verify clear local indication agrees with the transmitter.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Dirty glass is a credible limited degradation of readable local indication, while the observation does not establish complete loss or progression.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of local indication would remove a level-checking alternative, but transmitter-based level control was observed operating normally. No evidence links this gauge condition to loss of scrubber separation.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v3: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=3, I=3, base=3, final=3.

tickets.summary: INST-2151 produced a non-credible flat line for 36 hours, confirming loss of backup level measurement; cause may be a blocked impulse line or failed sensor.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect impulse line and sensor; repair per findings and prove level response against the sight glass. Check deviation record. Check level-loss hazards and exposure. Confirm backup protection role. Test duty channel and alarm.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: A non-credible flat line for approximately 36 hours directly demonstrates that INST-2151 is not providing responsive backup interface-level measurement.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure removes the backup measurement leg installed to maintain a two-leg arrangement after a near miss. The duty leg also had documented growing divergence while controlling, so healthy redundancy cannot be credited; consequences are materially operational, but the available evidence does not establish total level-control or alarm loss.

tickets.summary: North-quadrant deluge was isolated for an unknown period by an untagged, unregistered chained-closed valve; it was reopened, but restored delivery remains unverified after the prior failed flow test.
tickets.recommended_action: Fire-protection engineer to inspect and disposition the valve/branch, correct defects found, and full-flow test the quadrant. Check closure authority and valve controls. Check north-quadrant personnel exposure. Flow-test north quadrant.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The north-quadrant branch had a confirmed interruption of its required delivery function while isolated; reopening does not erase the observed failure or prove restored performance.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of north-quadrant deluge removes protection over two producing wellheads. DEL-8300 is an SCE with no redundancy, supporting severe major-accident exposure, though personnel exposure details are unknown.

tickets.summary: Wet insulation and rust staining at V-1201's manway indicate possible active CUI; shell condition is concealed, while loss of its first-stage pressure boundary could have severe consequences.
tickets.recommended_action: Remove manway insulation; integrity engineer to inspect/UT, disposition findings, repair as needed, and verify pressure-boundary acceptance. Check impairment/deviation register. Check inventory, pressure and exposure. Expose and UT the manway shell. Obtain integrity engineer disposition.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Wet insulation supports an active CUI precursor, but concealed shell condition and no reported weeping, cracking or wall-loss measurement leave near-term pressure-boundary failure uncertain.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this non-redundant SCE's pressure boundary could expose personnel and plant to a severe first-stage process release; evidence does not define the inventory or exposure needed to support an extreme band.
